title: Challenge document -- Steenbarger's QA read on the room before the vote (R36 round 1b)
x_purpose: Until 2026-11-01 this form had no schema (BUILD_PLAN Phase 1). The shape below is the one the seat has filed since 2026-09-06 (tests/fixtures/challenge_steenbarger.json), written down so registrar.py validate --kind challenge can refuse an incomplete one on arrival. Crowding, extension and overlap reads on the room; obligations addressed to named seats; never a nomination, never a vote. From 2026-11-01 only steenbarger files it (R31).

names_read.x_note: how many room names the seat actually read; 0 with findings filed is rejected

proof.x_note: a line number + text from the packet, proving it was read

kind.x_note: CROWDING | EXTENSION | OVERLAP | UNPROVEN | ANCHOR | PROCESS -- the seat's own labels; not an enum so the card can grow

ticker.x_note: when the finding is about one name; must be in the universe

evidence.x_note: served fields and values, by name

addressed_to.x_note: the seat(s) that owe an answer

x_registrar_extra_checks: a claim or evidence that uses a bracket term as a disqualifier => REJECT (R1)
r2digest refuses a filed document that renders to zero lines (silent-empty guard, unchanged)
